machine_start_gcode:
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
M104 S150 ; anti-ooze temp during homing AND probing
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; set final bed temp
G4 S30 ; allow partial nozzle warmup
G28 ; home all axes and restore leveling
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; wait for bed temp (needed for accurate mesh)
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE LOAD=default; hot bed, cool nozzle = no ooze on the bed
G1 Z50 F240
G1 X2.0 Y10 F3000
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; now bring nozzle to full temp
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for nozzle temp to stabilize
G1 Z0.28 F240
G92 E0
G1 X2.0 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime the nozzle
G1 X2.3 Y140 F5000
G92 E0
G1 X2.3 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime the nozzle
G92 E0
name: Creality Ender-5 S1 0.6 nozzle
